profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Results-driven Full-Stack Software Engineer with 6 years of experience in designing, developing, and delivering robust cloud-based solutions for leading organizations such as Capital One, T-Mobile, and WebstaurantStore. Proficient in a wide range of frameworks, with a strong foundation in programming languages. AWS Certified Solutions Architect with a proven track record of automating processes and enhancing operational efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborating across Agile teams to design, develop, test, and support Capital One’s Navigator Platforms, enhancing platform efficiency and user experience
• Utilizing full stack tech frameworks, along with AWS services to develop both frontend and backend components, improving system performance and scalability
• Working with digital product managers and other developers to deliver robust cloud-based solutions, enhancing the car buying experience for millions of Americans

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Created tools and controls to automate processes for SOX Compliance, reducing manual effort and increasing accuracy
• Designed a centralized dashboard/control center to visualize and operate automated processes, enhancing operational efficiency and decision-making
• Reviewed systems analysis, database design, testing, and documentation to ensure solutions were tested, extensible, maintainable, secure, and well-performing, using tools like SQL and .NET
positions.insights: Skills: Java · DevOps · Python (Programming Language) · Spring Boot · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed a multi-tenant e-commerce platform which served major chains such as Chick-fil-a, Subway, and Arby’s, enhancing their inventory shooping experiences
• Defined and implemented technical direction for platform development, improving system architecture and ensuring alignment with business goals
• Collaborated with colleagues to identify best-fit solutions for technical challenges using Agile methodology, leading to more efficient project delivery
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · React · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a dynamic web-based evaluation system for principals, supervisors, and teachers of WV
• Designed an Entity-Relationship model for the database using Laravel Migration, improving data organization and retrieval efficiency
• Communicated and coordinated with other senior developers and stakeholders in developing the system.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Database Design · Laravel · HTML

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed a solution for an IOT therapeutic tool for disable children.
• Created a jaw therapy exercise tool that can collect the chew pressure of user and send it to a server through Wifi.
• Customized an app that received all the data from those tools and put them into a website which parents can access and keep track of their children’s progress through web/mobile application.
• Got accepted for IEEE GLOBECOM 2019 presentation in Hawaii, USA.

positions.title: Research Assistant, SURE Fellowship
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an easy-deploy device that supports troubleshoot networks remotely.
• Integrated PoE function and tamper-proof case into a Single Board Computer (Raspberry Pi).
• Designed a software that can be used to extract information and location of the device remotely periodically using Python, Bash Script, and Geolocation API.
• Implemented a program that helps users control USB ports of the device remotely by using Bash Script and C.
• Enhanced the device’s security by implement a data lock function which can be activated when the device is stolen.

positions.title: Computer Tutor
positions.description:
● Supported and tutored students at Seminole State College in Mathematics, Physics, and Programming Languages.
● Coordinated with colleagues, school’s employees and professors.
● Maintained workplace’s equipment tools.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
